mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPI YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for two consecutive months and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000, but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both decline, but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, an increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in a month signals robust supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% during a late-cycle expansion, but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances over a 2-year rolling window.
